"the patient was not treated after 2 weeks" is kept only as an ambiguity; p1-e04 -> p1-e05 is supported because "after 2 weeks" in the adjacent sentence of the same paragraph is anchored to "anti-tuberculosis drugs were initiated".

Specimens: BAL/wound isolation (abstract), direct PCR of BAL and sequence analysis of the foot-wound isolate (b00014, one shared clause, two tests) are specimen-literal; isolate-level phenotype, biochemistry, susceptibility and DSH41 16S results keep specimen "isolate" because the source never says which specimen DSH41 came from.

p1-e09 -> p1-e10 accepted: "After clinical and laboratory diagnosis" back-references the single described diagnosis; p1-e10 -> p1-e11 rests on "subsequently" in the same sentence. Dissemination stays possible/provisional.

ESR unit kept as printed "mm h^(−1 )"; p1-f005 left-foot laterality is the same wound described in the abstract sentence, not a neighbouring fact; tuberculosis drugs are unnamed in the source; F5 bootstrap numbers are pixel content (visual.json only).
All 11 relations checked against their full evidence lists.
residual_risks: The genus-specific PCR is described as a 596 bp target while the Fig. 3 gel is captioned as 16SrRNA PCR amplification; no band size is read from the gel.
Which specimen yielded isolate DSH41 is not stated; Fig. 3 lane 1 is "DSH41 isolate from culture" and lane 2 "direct BAL samples", which does not establish the wound origin.
